name: iotdeviceadvisor
description: Amazon Web Services IoT Core Device Advisor is a cloud-based, fully managed test capability for validating IoT devices during device software development.

subcommands.name: create-suite-definition
subcommands.description: Creates a Device Advisor test suite.

subcommands.name: delete-suite-definition
subcommands.description: Deletes a Device Advisor test suite.

subcommands.name: get-endpoint
subcommands.description: Gets information about an Device Advisor endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-suite-definition
subcommands.description: Gets information about a Device Advisor test suite.

subcommands.name: get-suite-run
subcommands.description: Gets information about a Device Advisor test suite run.

subcommands.name: get-suite-run-report
subcommands.description: Gets a report download link for a successful Device Advisor qualifying test suite run.

subcommands.name: list-suite-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists the Device Advisor test suites you have created.

subcommands.name: list-suite-runs
subcommands.description: Lists runs of the specified Device Advisor test suite.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags attached to an IoT Device Advisor resource.

subcommands.name: start-suite-run
subcommands.description: Starts a Device Advisor test suite run.

subcommands.name: stop-suite-run
subcommands.description: Stops a Device Advisor test suite run that is currently running.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds to and modifies existing tags of an IoT Device Advisor resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an IoT Device Advisor resource.

subcommands.name: update-suite-definition
subcommands.description: Updates a Device Advisor test suite.
